business_definition: Provider information group containing NPI, Medicaid ID, provider type, taxonomy code, risk tier, enrollment status, effective date, revaluation due date, and legal name
National Provider Identifier (NPI) for the provider (PIC X(10))
Healthcare provider taxonomy classification code (PIC X(10))
Risk tier assignment level for the provider (PIC X(01))
Date when provider information becomes effective (PIC X(10))
Date when provider revaluation is due (PIC X(10))
Provider legal name group containing length and text fields
Length of provider legal name text in bytes (PIC S9(4) COMP)
Provider legal name text value (PIC X(60))
